name: Paper
description: Warm paper and muted gold. The default — quiet, readable, and easy on a dim projector.

vars.--deck-font: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

name: Georgia Tech
description: Official Georgia Tech palette — Tech Gold, Navy Blue, and Diploma ivory, using the accessible gold variants for text.

_palette.Tech Gold: #B3A369 (PMS 4515) — rules and bullets only; GT flags it as inaccessible for text
_palette.Tech Dark Gold: #857437 — GT's accessible small-bold gold, darkened to #7f6f34 to clear WCAG AA (4.58:1) on Diploma rather than 4.25:1

vars.--deck-font: Roboto Slab, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
vars.--ui-font: Roboto, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

name: Texas A&M
description: Official Texas A&M palette — Aggie Maroon and white, with the Aggie brand typefaces.

_palette.Aggie Maroon: #500000 (PMS 7421) — headings, and the flood on discussion slides
_palette.White: #FFFFFF — the other half of the primary palette; slide background
_palette.Brand Dark: #3C001C — the surround and the notes overlay
_palette._note: All values are official swatches used unmodified; every text/background pair clears WCAG AA, the tightest at 8.93:1.
_palette._fonts: Oswald for the uppercase micro-labels (its stated job), Work Sans and Open Sans for headings and body. Georgia is A&M's own sanctioned digital substitute for Crimson Text and is a system font, so it is the guaranteed fallback.

vars.--deck-font: Work Sans, Open Sans, Georgia, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
vars.--ui-font: Oswald, Work Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
